title: Matoke
description: Matoke is a Uganda classic prepared with plantain, banana leaf, peanut sauce. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used. Use green unripe cooking plantains to approximate East African matoke bananas, which are not separately listed.

steps.instruction: Wash and prepare the listed produce; dice or chop evenly for a consistent texture.
Place a portion of prepared filling on each leaf or wrapper, tuck in the sides and roll tightly into neat parcels.
Steam the leaf-wrapped unripe cooking plantains until very tender, then remove leaves carefully before mashing.
Drain the cooked ingredients and pound or mash while warm for about 12 minutes until thick, elastic and smooth; shape into portions with wet hands or a spoon.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
